description: Dopravní informace Plzeňského kraje do 1.1.2025 is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Plzeňský kraj. These are anonymized data on speed, the number of passages of the type of means of transport used on roads over time. Coverage: Plzeňský kraj. The portal shows the English title as "Transport information of the Pilsen Region until 1.1.2025" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Plzeňský kraj. Its keywords include dopravní prostředek, doprava, rychlost, čas. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70890366/682179464/distribuce/7707f354153543cded27bc48dedf4a2d/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
